description.value: The Frog Liquor Store is a neighbourhood institution that has been serving the Coquitlam–Port Moody border area since the 1980s. Originally part of a pub-and-liquor-store complex (the pub closed June 2024), the liquor store carries an extensive selection of craft beer, wine, and spirits. A local delivery service covers Coquitlam, Port Moody, and Port Coquitlam.
